chunks: From al-Mughīra ibn Saʿīd, Abū Jaʿfar (peace be upon him) came out and said:
Indeed he used to lie against us, and he used to call to Muḥammad ibn ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Ḥasan, in the beginning of his affair.

key_terms.أَبُو جَعْفَر: Abū Jaʿfar, referring to Imam al-Bāqir
key_terms.أَوَّلِ أَمْرِهِ: In the beginning of his affair/movement
key_terms.مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Muḥammad ibn ʿAbdullāh, known as Muḥammad al-Nafs al-Zakiyya
key_terms.يَكْذِبُ عَلَيْنَا: He used to lie against us

ai.seo_question: Who did Abū Jaʿfar (peace be upon him) say was lying against them and calling for Muḍammad ibn ʿAbdullāh?
ai.summary: Al-Mughīra ibn Saʿīd narrates that Abū Jaʿfar (Imam al-Bāqir) stated that a person used to lie against the Ahl al-Bayt and called for Muḥammad ibn ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Ḥasan during the early stage of his movement or cause.
